justifications.type_expressiveness: Solid enums for Expr, Value, BinOp, UnaryOp, and EvalError variants, but TypeError still wraps a String message rather than a structured variant carrying operator/operand types.
justifications.error_handling: Returns typed errors with the three required EvalError variants and avoids panics in normal paths, but uses unreachable! and unwrap on UTF-8 slices without documented justification, and ParseError carries a free-form String message.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Clean surface with required Display/Debug impls and a narrow API, but public items lack doc comments (only EvalError variants and ParseError have any), errors don't implement std::error::Error, and ParseError fields are exposed as pub.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with ?, matches!, and derives, but has some awkward spots like manual lookup loops instead of iterator find, repeated .clone() of tokens for peeking, and a manual Debug impl for ParseError instead of derive.
